subject.title: [Feature]: Add guarded keyboard shortcuts for session/agent switching in Control UI

question: Should Control UI support guarded positional/cyclic session or agent switching shortcuts, and what exact bindings, ordering, and focus guard should be canonical?
rationale: The code path is clear, but adding global dashboard shortcuts changes a first-party UX contract and could conflict with browser, input, picker, and adjacent dashboard-shortcut behavior.

options.title: Keep As Product Backlog
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose bindings and ordering, then implement it through the shared guarded shortcut dispatcher rather than a one-off handler.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions View Work
options.body: Track the shortcut contract under the broader sessions overview/navigation design if maintainers want keyboard switching to ship with that larger UI model.

options.title: Reject Positional Shortcuts
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers decide positional session keys are too conflict-prone or unstable for Control UI.

recommendation.title: Keep As Product Backlog
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose bindings and ordering, then implement it through the shared guarded shortcut dispatcher rather than a one-off handler.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the adjacent guarded dashboard shortcut discussion and active dispatcher PR, making them the best available owner for shortcut-contract coordination.
